parent_objective: audit measured off-track repair panel under pre-registered M1723 rules
blocked_by: need result audit before task-quality repair synthesis or redesign
supersedes: direct branch continuation after M1724 execution

public_gates: M1725 must audit M1724 execution pass/fail plumbing before interpreting task quality
M1725 must compare original_axis_baseline against best_off_track_variant, collision_control_wide_relaxed, and wide_relaxed_extended separately
M1725 must apply the pre-registered off-track improvement, collision-delta, and composite repair thresholds
M1725 must classify the result as full repair positive, composite repair positive, conditional repair retained, tradeoff-only, repair failed, or runner failure
M1725 must not run rollout train replay PPO promote use private holdout or change actor inputs
M1725 must not claim controller-family ranking, paper-level evidence, or level3 self-ID

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits fixed-budget off-track repair panel task-quality signal after measured execution
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: public diagnostic task-quality repair audit only; no rollout, training, replay, PPO, promotion, private holdout, controller ranking, paper-level or level3 claim
stop_condition: stop if required aggregates are missing
stop if all calibrated variants remain off-track dominated above 0.80
stop if no calibrated variant improves off-track rate by at least 0.10
stop if repair reduces off-track only by exceeding collision guard
fallback_plan: route to runner repair if M1724 execution failed
route to task-quality source redesign if repair failed
route to branch synthesis if the result is conditional, composite, or tradeoff-only
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1724 completed off-track repair panel execution

training_stage.stage_objective: audit off-track repair panel diagnostic result
admission_evidence: M1724 completed the fixed 864-episode off-track repair panel execution
blocked_shortcuts: do not claim controller ranking or level3 self-identification
allowed_updates: M1725 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up synthesis or redesign manifest
next_stage_criteria: variant-level off-track/collision tradeoff class is recorded

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: high; M1725 audits task quality and cannot prove history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: audit must keep profile rows as controls and must not convert them into self-ID claims
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If task-quality repair fails or is tradeoff-only, record that as scenario-design evidence rather than self-ID failure.
allowed_claims: off-track repair-panel public task-quality audit result
no rollout, training, replay, PPO, private-holdout, promotion, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: M1724 can be audited under the pre-registered M1723 collision/off-track rules to decide whether the repair panel gives a positive, conditional, tradeoff-only, or failed task-quality signal.
success_criteria: M1724 result_class and guardrails are audited
original_axis_baseline is used as the baseline variant
all three non-baseline repair variants are compared separately
offtrack_improvement and collision_delta are reported for each non-baseline variant
result class is one of full_repair_positive composite_repair_positive conditional_repair_retained tradeoff_only repair_failed runner_failure
rollout execution training replay PPO promotion private holdout actor-input changes and level3 claims remain blocked
failure_criteria: audit omits M1724 execution pass/fail checks
audit chooses a best variant without reporting all non-baseline variants
audit omits collision delta or composite delta
environment rollout training replay PPO private holdout promotion or actor-input changes occur

commands.name: audit
commands.command: write off-track repair panel result audit

decision_rule: M1725 passes if it audits M1724 under the pre-registered repair tradeoff rules and routes to redesign, synthesis, or the next paper-route stage without overclaiming.
